spec.task: Implement CONTRACTS/C3.md on autonomy/c3. Change only report_cli.py; leave job_report.py byte-identical and never modify tests/ or queue/NEXT.json. Accept --input files with a .csv suffix using the standard library csv module, reading id,state,priority header fields and converting priority to an integer before calling the existing summarize_jobs. CSV text output must match JSON text output for tests/fixtures/jobs.csv, including Next: J-02. Preserve existing JSON input, --json output and --format markdown output, and support both output options for CSV input. Reject malformed CSV, including a missing header, unknown state and non-integer priority, with a nonzero exit and a short stderr message. Do not add third-party dependencies or write files at runtime. Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_report_csv.py tests/test_report_cli.py -q and return the complete accepted report_cli.py bytes and their SHA-256 through the executor feed.
